title: UBUSHINJACYAHA v. TWAHIRWA N’ABANDI
text:
UBUSHINJACYAHA v. TWAHIRWA N’ABANDI
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RPAA 00269/2023/CA (Ndahayo, P.J.)
28 Mutarama 2026]
Amategeko agenga imiburanishirize y’imanza z’inshinjabyaha – Ubujurire – Ingingo y’ubujurire
itanzwe nyuma y’ibihe byo kujurira – Ingingo iyo ariyo yose itanzwe nyuma y’ibihe ntarengwa
byo kujurira, itari iyuzuza cyangwa isobanura iyatanzwe mu bihe byemewe byo kujurira,
ntiyakirwa.
Amategeko agenga imiburanishirize y’imanza z’inshinjabyaha – Ibimenyetso – Ufite inshingano
yo gutanga ibimenyetso – Mu manza z’inshinjabyaha, ntabwo buri ruhande rufite inshingano
y’ibyo rugomba gutangaho ibimenyetso, ahubwo iyo nshingano ifitwe n’urega ijana ku ijana, ni
ukuvuga Ubushinjacyaha cyangwa uregera indishyi iyo ahari.
Amategeko agenga imanza z’inshinjabyaha – Kwiba hakoreshejwe intwaro – Kugira ngo umuntu
yitwe ko yakoze icyaha cyo kwiba hakoreshejwe intwaro, uwiba agomba kuba yari yitwaje
igikoresho icyo ari cyo cyose, imbunda, icyuma cyangwa ikindi kintu cyose gitema, gitobora
cyangwa gisekura, gishobora kwica, gukomeretsa cyangwa gukubitishwa kigaragara cyangwa
gihishe cyangwa kibonetse hafi y’aho icyaha cyakorewe.
Amategeko agenga imiburanishirize y’imanza z’inshinjabyaha – Kugabanya igihano – Urukiko
ntirutegetswe kugabanya igihano n’iyo hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha, ahubwo rugena igihano
mu bushishozi bwarwo rurebye imikorere y’icyaha uregwa akurikiranyweho cyangwa uburyo
cyakozwemo.
Incamake y’ikibazo: Abitwa Twahirwa Jean Baptiste, Nsabimana Gilbert na Ndungutse Etienne
baketsweho icyaha cy’ubujura aho bamenaga amazu bitwikiriye ijoro bakiba ibikoresho
bitandukanye birimo flat screens n’ibindi. Ubushinjacyaha nyuma y’iperereza bwabaregeye
Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa rwa Nyarugenge busaba kwemeza ko ibyaha baregwa bigize
impurirane mbonezamugambi, kandi ko bibahama, rukabahanisha igifungo cy'imyaka
makumyabiri (20) n'ihazabu ya miliyoni zirindwi (7.000.000 Frw) kuri buri wese.
Urwo Rukiko rwaciye urubanza rwemeza ko abaregwa bahamwa n’icyaha, Nsabimana Gilbert na
Twahirwa Jean Baptiste bahamwa n’icyaha cyo kwiba hakoreshejwe guca icyuho bikozwe nijoro
n’abantu barenze umwe hamwe n’icyaha cyo kwiba hakoreshejwe intwaro, bikaba bigize
impurirane mbonezamugambi, rubahanisha igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka 20 n’ihazabu
y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyoni eshanu (5,000,000 Frw) buri wese.
Abaregwa bajuririye Urukiko Rukuru, Ndungutse Etienne na Nsabimana Gilbert bavuga ko
Urukiko rwabanje rwabahamije icyaha cy’ubujura bukoresheje intwaro kandi ataribyo, icyo
bemera kikaba ari ubujura buciye icyuho naho Twahirwa Jean Baptiste we yajuriye avuga ko
yagombaga guhamwa n’icyaha cy’ubujura busanzwe kuko aricyo yakoze.
Urwo Rukiko rwaciye urubanza rwemeza ko nta makosa urukiko rwabanje rwakoze rubahamya
ibyaha byo kwiba hakoreshejwe guca icyuho bikozwe nijoro n’abantu barenze umwe hamwe
n’icyaha cyo kwiba hakoreshejwe intwaro, rugumishaho imikirize y’urubanza rwajuririwe.

Abaregwa bajuririye mu Rukiko rw’Ubujurire, Twahirwa avuga ko inyito y’icyaha yahaniwe
yahinduka agahanirwa icyaha cy’ubujura busanzwe, ndetse akavuga ko uhereye igihe icyaha
cyabereye habayeho ubusaze kuko imyaka 3 yashize, ndetse akavuga ko yamaze kugihanirwa kuko
yajyanywe I Wawa.
Ndungutse avuga ko Urukiko Rukuru rwamuhamije ibyaha byo kwibisha intwaro rwirengagije
ibimenyetso yarugaragarije, akaba asaba guhindurirwa inyito y’icyaha agahamwa n’ubujura
buciye icyuho gusa. Ndetse akora n’umwanzuro w’inyongera avuga ko atagombaga guhamwa
n’icyaha cy’ubujurire bwitwaje intwaro kuko ijeke yakoresheje itari intwaro.
Nsabimana yajuriye asaba urukiko kumuhindurira inyito y’icyaha, agahanirwa icyaha cy’ubujura
bworoheje.
Ku bujurire bwa Nsabimana, Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko busanga iyi mpamvu y’ubujurire
itagomba kwakirwa ngo isuzumwe kuko atigeze agaragaza icyo anenga urubanza ajurira mu
mwanzuro we usibye kuvuga gusa ko atishimiye imikirize y’urubanza, impamvu z’ubujurire akaba
yarazitanze mu mwanzuro w’inyongera bukaba bubona zaratanzwe igihe cyo kujurira
cyararangiye zikaba zitagomba kwakirwa ngo zisuzumwe kuko zituzuza cyangwa ngo zisobanure
izatanzwe mu gihe gikurikije amategeko.
Kuri Twahirwa, Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko ibijyanye no kuvuga ko icyaha yagihaniwe kuko
yajyanwe iwawa nta shingiro bifite kuko atari Urukiko, kandi ko ibijyanye n’imyanzuro
y’inyongera yatanzwe nyuma asaba kugabanyirizwa ibihano idakwiye kwakirwa kuko ituzuza
iyatanzwe mbere. Ku bijyanye no guhindurirwa inyito y’icyaha bisabwa na bose, Ubushinjacyaha
busaba Urukiko kuzemeza ko nta shingiro bifite.
Kuri Ndungutse, Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko adakwiye kwemererwa guhindurirwa inyito y’icyaha
cyane ko adahakana ko yakoresheje ijeki yiba, bityo akaba akwiye gukomeza guhanirwa icyaha
cy’ubujura bukoresheje intwaro.
Incamake y’icyemezo: 1. Ingingo iyo ariyo yose itanzwe nyuma y’ibihe ntarengwa byo kujurira,
itari iyuzuza cyangwa isobanura iyatanzwe mu bihe byemewe byo kujurira, ntiyakirwa.
2. Mu manza z’inshinjabyaha, ntabwo buri ruhande rufite inshingano y’ibyo rugomba gutangaho
ibimenyetso, ahubwo iyo nshingano ifitwe n’urega ijana ku ijana, ni ukuvuga Ubushinjacyaha
cyangwa uregera indishyi iyo ahari. Ibyo bimenyetso bikaba bireba ibigize icyaha byose.
3. Kugira ngo umuntu yitwe ko yakoze icyaha cyo kwiba hakoreshejwe intwaro, uwiba agomba
kuba yari yitwaje igikoresho icyo ari cyo cyose, imbunda, icyuma cyangwa ikindi kintu cyose
gitema, gitobora cyangwa gisekura, gishobora kwica, gukomeretsa cyangwa gukubitishwa
kigaragara cyangwa gihishe cyangwa kibonetse hafi y’aho icyaha cyakorewe.
4. Urukiko ntirutegetswe kugabanya igihano n’iyo hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha, ahubwo rugena
igihano mu bushishozi bwarwo rurebye imikorere y’icyaha uregwa akurikiranyweho cyangwa
uburyo cyakozwemo.
Ubujurire bwa Nsabimana ntibwakiriwe.
Ubujurire bwatanzwe Ndungutse Etienne bufite ishingiro gusa ku bijyanye no
kugabanyirizwa ibihano.
Twahirwa Jean Baptiste ahamwa n’icyaha cyo kwiba.

Imikirize y’urubanza rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rukuru rujuririrwa ihindutse kuri bimwe.
Amategeko yashingiweho:
Ingingo ya 6 y’Itegeko Nº 027/2019 ryo ku wa 19/09/2019 ryerekeye imiburanishirize y’imanza
z’inshinjabyaha;
Imanza zifashishijwe:
RCOMAA 00071/2017/CS; MBUTO AIMABLE vs BRD rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ku wa
26/10/2018;
RS/INJUST/RP 00007/2018/SC; Ubushinjacyaha buburana vs SAMUDUHA INTEGRATED
COLLEGE (SICO), mu izina ry’Umuyobozi wayo, na Mbarushimana Bernard,
Murangira Gilbert na Nzabahimana Thomas rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ku wa
30/10/2020;
RPA 0282/08/CS; Ubushinjacyaha vs Nyirangondo Virginie rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ku
wa 12/03/2010;
RPAA 00436/2023/CA; Ubushinjacyaha vs Rukundo Elia rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku
wa 28/05/2025;
RPAA 00521/2023/CA; Ubushinjacyaha vs Nsengiyumva Vianney bita KIDERI rwaciwe
n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 27/01/2025;
RPAA 00406/2020/CA; Ubushinjacyaha vs Nahayo Ignace rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku
wa 22/10/2021.
Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA
[1] Kuva mu mwaka wa 2015, hari ingo z’abaturage i Kigali no mu tundi turere dutandukanye
zagiye ziterwa n’abajura bakitwikira ijoro bitwaje intwaro, bakamena inzu bakiba ibikoresho
bitandukanye nka za Flat screen n’ibindi. Mu bantu baketsweho gukora ibyo bikorwa harimo
Twahirwa Jean Baptiste, Nsabimana Gilbert na Ndungutse Etienne.
[2] Iperereza rirangiye Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko bwasanze bari bararemye umutwe
w’abagizi ba nabi maze bubarega mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge busaba kwemeza ko
ibyaha baregwa bigize impurirane mbonezamugambi, kandi ko bibahama, rukabahanisha igifungo
cy'imyaka makumyabiri (20) n'ihazabu ya miliyoni zirindwi (7.000.000 Frw) kuri buri wese.
[3] Nsabimana Gilbert yaburanye ahakana ibyaha aregwa avuga ko nta mutwe w’abagizi ba
nabi yashyizeho, ntawo yagiyemo nta n’uwo yabayemo kuko mubo baregwa hamwe ntawe
asanzwe azi, ko icyo yemera ari uko yajyanye na Ndungutse Etienne kwiba umuturanyi wabo
Mujawase Germaine, ari mu ma saa kumi n’imwe za mugitondo, binjira mu nzu ye babanje
kugonda grillage bakoresheje ijeke, bamwiba televiseur yari muri salon.
[4] Ndungutse Etienne yaburanye avuga ko yemera ko yajyanye na Nsabimana Gilbert kwiba
uwo muturanyi wabo, yongeraho ko ibindi yavuze mu ibazwa rye yabitewe n’agahato
yashyizweho.

[5] Twahirwa Jean Baptiste nawe yaburanye avuga ko icyo yemera ari uko yagiye kwiba
televiseur kwa mukuru we n’izindi yibye muri atelier ko ariko ibyo yamaze kubihanirwa kuko
yajyanywe i Wawa akamarayo umwaka wose.
[6] Mu rubanza RP 00433/2021/TGI/NYGE rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa
Nyarugenge ku wa 31/12/2021, hemejwe ko Ndungutse Etienne, Nsabimana Gilbert na Twahirwa
Jean Baptiste bahamwa n’icyaha cyo kwiba hakoreshejwe guca icyuho bikozwe nijoro n’abantu
barenze umwe hamwe n’icyaha cyo kwiba hakoreshejwe intwaro, bikaba bigize impurirane
mbonezamugambi, rubahanisha igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka 20 n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u
Rwanda miliyoni eshanu (5,000,000 Frw) buri wese.
[7] Ku bijyanye na Nsabimana Gilbert Urukiko rwashingiye ku kuba yemera ko yatangiye
kwiba mu mwaka wa 2020, agasobanura uko mu bihe bitandukanye yagiye yinjira mu bipangu
by’abantu akanura imyenda n’ibindi bintu asanze hanze birimo amasafuriya akabyiba, akaza
gufatwa akajyanwa i Gikondo kwa Kabuga, aho yahuriye na Ndungutse Etienne uyu nawe bakaba
barajyanye kwiba inshuro imwe ku muturanyi wabo Germaine, izindi nshuro ebyiri ajya kwiba ari
wenyine, hamwe akaba yaribye amaze kwica ingufuri.
[8] Ku bijyanye na Ndungutse Etienne, Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwashingiye ku kuba nawe
abazwa yeremeye ko yajyanye na Nsabimana Gilbert kwiba inshuro ebyiri, bakagenda bitwaje ibiti
bakoreshaga bagonda grillage z’amadirishya banyuramo binjira mu nzu bakiba, akaba kandi
yemera ko yafatanywe icyuma cy’ijeke avuga ko yahawe na mugenzi we ngo ajye akoresha muri
ubwo bujura.
[9] Ku bijyanye na Twahirwa Jean Baptiste Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwasobanuye ko ahakana
ibyaha ariko akaba mu Bugenzacyaha yaravuze ko yatangiye ubujura mu mwaka wa 2015,
agafatwa amaze kwiba televiseur 3 ahantu hatandukanye, ari kumwe n’abandi bajura barimo na
murumuna we.
[10] Ndungutse Etienne, Nsabimana Gilbert na Twahirwa Jean Baptiste bajuririye Urukiko
Rukuru, Ndungutse Etienne na Nsabimana Gilbert bavuga ko Urukiko rwabanje rwabahamije
icyaha cy’ubujura bukoresheje intwaro kandi ataribyo, icyo bemera kikaba ari ubujura buciye
icyuho naho Twahirwa Jean Baptiste we yajuriye avuga ko yagombaga guhamwa n’icyaha
cy’ubujura busanzwe kuko aricyo yakoze.
[11] Mu rubanza RPA 00206-CMB 00137-CMB 00148-00212/2022/HC/KIG, rwaciwe
n’Urukiko Rukuru ku wa 5/4/2023, rushingiye ku mvugo za Ndungutse Etienne, Nsabimana
Gilbert na Twahirwa Jean Baptiste zo mu Bugenzacyaha nk’uko Urukiko Rwisumbuye
rwazigarutseho, no ku mvugo za Bayingana Jean Paul zigaragaza ko yaguraga ibikoresho
n’abajura, rwemeje ko bose nta wabashije kugaragaza ibimenyetso bivuguruza ibyashingiweho ku
rwego rwa mbere, bityo ko nta makosa urukiko rwabanje rwakoze rubahamya ibyaha byo kwiba
hakoreshejwe guca icyuho bikozwe nijoro n’abantu barenze umwe hamwe n’icyaha cyo kwiba
hakoreshejwe intwaro, rugumishaho imikirize y’urubanza rwajuririwe.
[12] Twahirwa Jean Baptiste, Nsabimana Gilbert na Ndungutse Etienne, bajuririye mu Rukiko
rw’Ubujurire, urubanza ruhabwa RPAA 00269/2023/CA ruburanishwa ku wa 09/1/2026,

Twahirwa Jean Baptiste yunganiwe na Me Nkundimpaye Ismaël, Nsabimana Gilbert yunganiwe
na Me Karangwa Olivier naho Ndungutse Etienne yunganiwe na Me Mutabaruka Aristide.
[13] Mu myanzuro y’ubujurire ya Twahirwa Jean Baptiste yo ku wa 16/4/2023 yavuze ko
Urukiko Rukuru nta kindi kimenyetso rwashingiyeho rumuhamya ibyaha uretse imvugo ze gusa
zigaragaza ko mu mwaka wa 2015 yakoze ubujura bwa televiseur yibye kwa mukuru we
Ngirababyeyi Jean Claude aho yabaga, n’izindi 2 yibye muri atelier zari iza Niyibigena Emmanuel,
kandi aho hose akaba nta cyuho yaciye cyangwa ngo akoreshe intwaro bityo akaba asaba ko
hakwemezwa ko icyaha yakoze ari ubujura busanzwe.
[14] Anavuga ko ashingiye ku ngingo ya 6 y’Itegeko No 027/2019 ryo ku wa 19/09/2019
ryerekeye imiburanishirize y’imanza z’inshinjabyaha mu gika cyayo cya kabiri iteganya ko
ikurikiranacyaha ry’icyo cyaha ari imyaka 3, ngo abona ko icyo cyaha cyashaje harebwe igihe
yafatiwe ku wa 18/2/2021, akaba asaba uru Rukiko gukosora ayo makosa ariko rwabibona ukundi
rukamuhindurira inyito y’icyaha agahamwa n’icyaha cy’ubujura busanzwe kuko Ubushinjacyaha
nta kindi kimenyetso bwabashije gutanga kimuhuza n’ubundi bujura bivugwa ko yaba yarakoranye
nabo baregwa hamwe.
[15] Ku wa 1/5/2023 yakoze umwanzuro w’inyongera anenga Urukiko Rukuru kuba rwaremeje
ko atabashije gutanga ibimenyetso bivuguruza iby’urukiko rwabanje rwashingiyeho rumuhamya
ibyaha, birimo no kuba hari ibyo yemeye mu Bugenzacyaha yagera mu rukiko akabihakana kandi
atarigeze ahindura imvugo ze, ko ahubwo yagaragaje neza ko ubujura yakoze mu mwaka wa 2015
ari ubusanzwe.
[16] Mu myanzuro y’ubujurire ya Ndungutse Etienne yo ku wa 16/4/2023 mu Rukiko
rw’Ubujurire avuga ko Urukiko Rukuru rwamuhamije ibyaha byo kwibisha intwaro rwirengagije
ibimenyetso yarugaragarije, akaba asaba guhindurirwa inyito y’icyaha agahamwa n’ubujura
buciye icyuho gusa.
[17] Ku wa 5/6/2023, yakoze umwanzuro w’inyongera avuga ko anenga Urukiko Rukuru kuba
rwaremeje ko atabashije kuvuguruza ko atakoze icyaha cy’ubujura bwitwaje intwaro rugaragaza
ijeke nk’intwaro yakoreshejwe, nyamara ijeke itafatwa nk’intwaro ashingiye ku zindi manza
zaciwe zabaye itegeko nk’urubanza RP 00657/2021/TB/GSBO rwarezwemo Ntakirutimana
Claude na Tuyisenge Eric nabo bafatafanywe ijeke na tourne-vis bakoreshaga baca icyuho bakaba
barahamijwe icyaha cy’ubujura buciye icyuho hakoresheje ijeke ariko ko batahamijwe kwibisha
intwaro, nawe akaba abona aricyo cyaha yahanirwa. Akomeza avuga ko ikindi anenga ari uko
ashinjwa icyaha cy’ubujura bwakorewe Uwimana Ferdinand, atakoze, kuko cyahamijwe
MUGENERWA mu rubanza RP 00250/2021/TB/NYGE kandi uwo akaba ntaho yagaragaje ko
yigeze aba umufatanyacyaha we, ari nabyo bigaragaza ko atibye ahantu henshi hatandukanye
nk’uko abishinjwa, akaba asaba uru Rukiko kumuhindurira inyito y’icyaha agahamwa n’ubujura
buciye icyuho gusa aho kuba n’ubwitwaje intwaro.
[18] Ku wa 17/4/2023, Nsabimana Gilbert yajuririye Urukiko rw’Ubujurire avuga ko atishimiye
imikirize y’urubanza rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rukuru, ko azagaragaza impamvu ze z’ubujurire mu
buryo burambuye.

[19] Ku wa 5/6/2023, Nsabimana Gilbert yakoze umwanzuro w’inyongera avuga ko yajuriye
asaba urukiko kumuhindurira inyito y’icyaha, ko aho yemera yakoreye ubujura ari kwa Mujawase
Germaine gusa kandi ko ijeke yagiye yitwaje yo kugonda grillage y’idirishya ngo abone uko
yinjira mu nzu yibe itagombaga gufatwa nk’intwaro, kuko ukurikije urubanza RP
00657/2021/TB/GSBO rwarezwemo Ntakirutimana Claude na Tuyisenge Eric rwemeje ko ijeke
bafatanywe yari iyo guca icyuho, ntibahamwa no kwibisha iyo jeke nk’intwaro ahubwo bahamwa
n’ubujura buciye icyuho, ko rero nawe aricyo cyaha gikwiye kumuhama.
[20] Ku bijyanye na Nsabimana Gilbert Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko busanga iyi mpamvu
y’ubujurire itagomba kwakirwa ngo isuzumwe kuko atigeze agaragaza icyo anenga urubanza
ajurira mu mwanzuro we usibye kuvuga gusa ko atishimiye imikirize y’urubanza, impamvu
z’ubujurire akaba yarazitanze mu mwanzuro w’inyongera bukaba bubona zaratanzwe igihe cyo
kujurira cyararangiye zikaba zitagomba kwakirwa ngo zisuzumwe kuko zituzuza cyangwa ngo
zisobanure izatanzwe mu gihe gikurikije amategeko.
[21] Kuri Twahirwa Jean Baptiste, Ubushinjacyaha bwavuze ko ibijyanye no kuvuga ko icyaha
yagihaniwe kuko yajyanwe iwawa nta shingiro bifite kuko atari Urukiko, kandi ko ibijyanye
n’imyanzuro y’inyongera yatanzwe nyuma asaba kugabanyirizwa ibihano idakwiye kwakirwa
kuko ituzuza iyatanzwe mbere. Ku bijyanye no guhindurirwa inyito y’icyaha bisabwa na bose,
Ubushinjacyaha busaba Urukiko kuzemeza ko nta shingiro bifite.
[22] Urukiko ruhereye kuri izi mpaka, rusanga ibibazo bikwiye gusuzumwa ari ibi bikurikira:
1) kumenya niba ubujurire bwatanzwe na Nsabimana Gilbert bwakwakirwa
bugasuzumwa;
2) kumenya niba inyito y’icyaha Twahirwa Jean Baptiste aregwa yahinduka ikaba ubujura
bworoheje aho kuba ubujura bwitwaje intwaro no kumenya niba yarahaniwe icyo cyaha
kandi cyarashaje;
3) kumenya niba inyito y’icyaha Ndungutse Etienne yahamijwe yahinduka ikaba ubujura
buciye icyuho aho kuba ubujura bwitwaje intwaro;
4) kumenya niba Ndungutse Etienne na Twahirwa Jean Baptiste bagabanyirizwa ibihano.
II. IBIBAZO BIGIZE URU RUBANZA N’ISESENGURA
RYABYO
1) Kumenya niba ubujurire bwatanzwe na Nsabimana Gilbert bwakwakirwa
bugasuzumwa

[23] Uburanira Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko ubujurire bwa Nsabimana Gilbert budakwiye
kwakirwa1 kuko mu mwanzuro we atigeze agaragaza icyo anenga urubanza ajuririra cyangwa
amakosa yakozwe n’Urukiko Rukuru, uretse kuvuga gusa ko atishimiye imikirize y’urubanza.
[24] Ku bijyanye n’impamvu z’ubujurire yashyize mu mwanzuro w’inyongera wo ku wa
5/6/2023 n’uw’umwunganizi we wo ku wa 3/10/2025, Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko impamvu
zikubiye muri iyo myanzuro zatanzwe igihe cyo kujurira cyararangiye, ko zitagomba kwakirwa
ngo zisuzumwe kuko zituzuza cyangwa ngo zisobanure izatanzwe mu gihe gikurikije amateko
[25] Bukomeza buvuga ko uru Rukiko rubibonye ukundi ikibazo cy’uko ijeke yari yitwaje ajya
kwiba idakwiye gufatwa nk’intwaro nta shingiro iyo mpamvu ye y’ubujurire yahabwa kuko
ikibazo nk’icyo cyatanzweho umurongo mu rubanza RPAA 00521/2023/CA, rwaciwe ku wa
27/01/2025 haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Nsengiyumva Vianney bita KIDERI (igika cya 16),
Urubanza RPAA 00248/2021/CA, rwaciwe ku wa 28/03/2025 haburana Ubushinjacyaha na
Michael SULULU MARUGIRA, zasobanuye ubujura bukoreshejwe intwaro nk’uko
zagarutsweho haruguru, ko rero icyaha cy’ubujura bukoreshejwe intwaro nacyo gikwiye
kumuhama kuko adahakana ko yitwazaga iyo jeke.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[26] Impaka kuri iki kibazo zishingiye ku kumenya niba ubujurire bwatanzwe na Nsabimana
Gilbert ku wa 17/04/2023 butakwakirwa ngo busuzumwe kuko Nsabimana Gilbert atigeze
agaragaza icyo anenga urubanza ajurira.

[65] Ndungutse Etienne n’umwunganira bavuga basaba ko yagabanyirizwa igihano kuko kuva
yafatwa haba mu Bugenzacyaha, mu Bushinjacyaha no mu Rukiko yemeraga icyaha yakoze

[66] Uburanira Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko, kuri Twahirwa Jean Baptiste n’umwunganira,
impamvu y’ubujurire yo gusaba kugabanyirizwa ibihano itagomba kwakirwa ngo isuzumwe, kuko

rwaramutwerereye imvugo yo guhakana icyaha ngo abitewe n’inkoni kandi ntaho yabivuze, kuba
rero mu mwanzuro w’inyongera avuga ko ajurira kubera ko yahanishijwe igihano kiremereye,
bigakorwa mu mwanzuro watanzwe kuwa 30/10/2025, ajuririra urubanza rwaciwe kuwa 5/4/2023,
uyu mwanzuro ukaba utuzuza cyangwa ngo usobanure uwatanzwe mu bihe byemewe

UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[69] Impaka kuri iki kibazo zishingiye ku kumenya niba ingingo yo kugabanyirizwa igihano
kuri Twahirwa Jean Baptiste yakwakirwa igasuzumwa, we na Ndungutse Etienne bagabanyirizwa
ibihano.
[70] Mu gusesengura iki kibazo, hakwifashishwa umurongo watanzwe mu rubanza RPA
0282/08/CS rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ku wa 12/03/2010 haburana Ubushinjacyaha na
Nyirangondo Virginie, (Icyegeranyo cy’ibyemezo by’inkiko, Igitabo cya mbere, nº 8, Mutarama
2011, page 21-22). Urukiko ntirutegetswe kugabanya igihano n’iyo hari impamvu
nyoroshyacyaha, ahubwo rugena igihano mu bushishozi bwarwo rurebye imikorere y’icyaha
uregwa akurikiranyweho cyangwa uburyo cyakozwemo.
[71] Ku kijyane no kongera kugabanyiriza umuburanyi kubera impamvu nyoroshyacyaha,
hakwifashishwa umurongo watanzwe mu rubanza RPAA 00406/2020/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 22/10/2021, haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Nahayo Ignace (igika cya 22),
usobanura ko nta cyabuza Urukiko rwajuririwe kongera kugabanya igihano mu gihe rusanga
igihano cyatanzwe n’Urukiko rubanza kitaragabanyijwe mu buryo buhagije ubirebeye hamwe
n’uburemere bw’icyaha cyakozwe.
[72] Dosiye igaragaza ko Ndungutse Etienne, na Twahirwa Jean Baptiste bahamijwe n’Urukiko
Rukuru icyaha cyo kwiba hakoreshejwe guca icyuho bikozwe nijoro n’abantu barenze umwe
hamwe n’icyaha cyo kwiba hakoreshejwe intwaro, rubahanisha igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka 20
n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyoni eshanu (5,000,000 Frw) buri wese.
[73] Urukiko rurasanga kuri Ndungutse Etienne yarakomeje kwemera ibikorwa bigize icyaha
aregwa kuko icyo ahakana ari inyito y’ibikorwa bigize icyaha yemera mu mategeko ibyo bikaba
atari uguhakana icyaha aregwa bityo rero akaba agomba kugabanyirizwa ibihano hashingiwe kuri
uko kwemera icyaha no gusaba imbabazi.
[74] Urukiko rurasanga kandi kuri Twahirwa Jean Baptiste ubujurire bwe ku bijyanye no
kugabanyirizwa ibihano bwasuzumwa n’uru rukiko kuko uretse kuba ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko
yabisabye akererewe ariko kuba ubujurire bwe bwarakiriwe ntacyabuza urukiko gusuzuma niba
igihano cyatanzwe gihuye n’uburemere bw’icyaha cyakozwe.
[75] Urukiko rurasanga nk’uko byasobanuwe, icyaha gihama Twahirwa Jean Baptiste ari
ubujura bworoheje giteganywa n’ingingo ya 166 y’itegeko Nº68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018
riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange ivuga ko umuntu wese uhamijwe n’urukiko icyaha cyo
kwiba, ahanishwa igifungo kitari munsi y’umwaka umwe (1) ariko kitarenze imyaka ibiri (2)
n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda atari munsi ya miliyoni imwe (1.000.000 FRW) ariko
atarenze miliyoni ebyiri (2.000.000 Frw).

[76] Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga Twahirwa Jean Baptiste agomba guhanishwa igifungo
cy’imyaka 2 n’ihazabu ya 2 000 000frw kuko rubona aricyo gihuye n’icyaha yakoze cyo kwiba
ibikoresho bifite agaciro kanini akabyiba aho yakoraga ndetse no ku muvandimwe we babanaga,
yirengagije ikizere yagiriwe n’abo bantu.
[77] Urukiko rurasanga ariko icyo gihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka ibiri kandi akaba yarakimaze
muri gereza harebwe igihe yafatiwe agafungwa ku wa 18/02/2021 bityo hakaba hagomba
kwemezwa ko ahita afungurwa uru rubanza rukimara gusomwa.
[78] Kuri Ndungutse Etienne, Urukiko rurasanga hashingiwe ku kuba aho yaburanye hose
yaragiye yemera ibikorwa bigize icyaha aregwa nk’uko byasobanuwe haruguru byatuma
agabanyirizwa ibihano agahanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5 000 000 frw.
